Live arousal prediction from a Bluetooth stroker (Intiface/buttplug) plus an edging director that learns during the session. Predictor: a 10-parameter mechanistic ODE fit gradient-free by CEM. Director: a frozen CfC encoder in numpy feeding three Bayesian-linear heads adapted online by RLS and picked by Thompson sampling. Three forced duplications -- the ODE in two layouts, the encoder in numpy and torch, the setpoint graded and binned -- each have a gate that blocks export when the copies disagree, each verified by breaking it. LOSO over 4 CEM seeds. Revision 1 is the earlier no-network design. Training data included (9 sessions, 11128 commands).
